item.title: Caregiving & Flexible Work Support
item.description: Caring for kids or ageing parents? Flexible working arrangements are available at LeavePlus and under Fair Work. Planning early makes a real difference.

item.title: Mabo Day – Wednesday 3 June
item.description: Wednesday 3 June marks Mabo Day, commemorating Eddie Koiki Mabo and the overturning of terra nullius. A moment to reflect on reconciliation.

item.title: Vehicle Rego Rebate – Apply from 1 June
item.description: Eligible Victorians can claim a 20% rebate on light vehicle registration via Service Victoria, saving up to $186 per vehicle. Expect high demand.

item.title: Half Price Public Transport from 1 June
item.description: From 1 June to 1 January 2027, all Victorian public transport is half price for everyone, every day. Just tap on as usual. Saves commuters $850+.

item.title: Committee Meetings – Wednesday 3 June
item.description: The Remuneration, People & Culture Committee and the Audit, Risk & Compliance Committee both meet on Wednesday 3 June.

item.title: CMS Salesforce Listening Post #3 – Wed 9.30am
item.description: Salesforce users: join Listening Post #3 this Wednesday at 9.30am in L5 breakout or via Teams. Hear about upcoming CMS releases and ask questions.

item.title: Long Service Readers Book Club – Tue 2 June
item.description: The Long Service Readers of LeavePlus meet Tuesday 2 June in L5 breakout for their monthly chat. Everyone welcome. The club is also on Goodreads.

item.title: Winter Step Up & Move Challenge – Starts Today
item.description: 60 staff have signed up! The Wellness Committee's team-based step challenge runs all June. Open to all fitness levels - walking, gym, yoga, running.

item.title: EOI: Present the Acknowledgement of Country
item.description: Interested in presenting the Acknowledgement of Country at a Town Hall? Sign up to take part. Your voice can make this moment meaningful for all.

item.title: Catch Up on Past Town Halls
item.description: Missed a Town Hall? You can access all previous sessions any time via the All Staff Teams channel.

item.title: Sit/Stand Desks – Handle With Care
item.description: Please be gentle with the desk controller - it's a sensitive electrical part. Several desks have needed repairs after heavy-handed use.

item.title: Kitchen Tidiness – Clean Up Every Time
item.description: Please clean up after yourself in the kitchens, every time. Forgotten or expired food will be binned each Friday.

item.title: Habitat for Humanity 2026 Volunteer Program
item.description: Lend a helping hand to those in need - join the 2026 Habitat for Humanity volunteer program. See The Hub for details on how to take part.

item.title: Wellness Corner – Cultivate a Positive Mindset
item.description: Mindset is everything. Notice negative thought patterns and counter them with positive thoughts or affirmations for a healthier you.
